item.description:
Filter the conversation list by what you care about — Mail’s View > Filter idiom, adapted for Pits.

  • New View > Filter submenu with a master Enable Conversation Filter command (⌘L) and three category sections — Open state:, Cache state:, and Location:. Each category is a strict either-or pair: clicking one un-checks its sibling, clicking the active one un-checks it (so “neither” is reachable but “both” is not). The master label flips to Disable Conversation Filters (plural) when filters are active in 2+ categories.
  • Toolbar funnel with a state-aware tooltip (Filter conversations ↔︎ Unfilter conversations). The “on” state is signaled by a burnt-amber disc behind the funnel — Pits now has its own warm-amber accent color (formerly the system blue), which propagates through menu checkmarks, picker selection, and focus rings.
  • Toolbar ellipsis next to the funnel surfaces the same Filter content as a popover, so you can see (and edit) which dimensions are currently narrowing the list without going through the menu bar.
  • Master and sub-filters stay in sync (Mail’s behavior): un-checking the last active sub-filter automatically disables the master, and re-enabling the master with no subs checked auto-checks Open sessions as the default. The funnel’s on/off state always reflects whether something is actually being filtered.
  • Sub-filters compose across categories via AND. So Open sessions + Warm cache shows live, recently-touched conversations; add Repo to narrow to live recent work in git-tracked projects.
  • No sounds play for conversations excluded by an active filter — chimes for filtered-out activity are noise; gated automatically. Settings → Sounds carries a note explaining this.
  • Past-day slices of multi-day open conversations now show a hollow accent dot — visually linking them to the parent’s live status without overstating their own activity.
  • Project labels (the path-shaped caption above each conversation row) now render with per-component truncation and a middot separator. Single-segment captions for non-repo conversations.
  • Under the hood: conversation snapshots now track cwd and gitBranch per session, persisted across launches (cache schema bumped 4→5). The filter logic is extracted into testable static functions; the test suite gained ~15 cases pinning the new behavior.
